spec.studio_prompt: A minimalist modern oak nightstand measuring 45 cm wide, 35 cm deep, and 50 cm high. Constructed entirely from warm-toned oak featuring visible subtle linear wood grain in rich amber and deep chestnut shades (#512c16, #784c2a, and #a58d6b). The structure features a flat rectangular top with softly radiused exterior vertical corners extending downward into smooth, curved side panels. An open lower cubby shelf creates functional recessed storage with flush internal joins, presenting a clean, monolithic, organic-modern aesthetic with a smooth matte protective finish.
